commit.message:
Fix verbose info for standalone bag files (#2449)

Verbose info joined each metadata file path to the input URI under the
assumption that the URI was a directory. For a standalone bag file,
this produced a path such as sample.mcap/sample.mcap.

Resolve metadata file paths from the bag directory or from the parent
of a standalone bag file.

Signed-off-by: Old-Ding <35417409+Old-Ding@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
Fix ros2 interface show --no-comments leaving bare # lines (#1257)

The is_comment() method checked the rosidl_adapter parser result and
only matched bare `#` (no leading whitespace, no comment text) via a
strip-then-equality check. This missed indented comments like `    #`
and `    # comment` -- those lines leaked through `--no-comments`.

Fix: check lstrip().startswith("#") instead of relying on the parser.
This catches `#`, `    #`, `# comment`, and `    # comment`, while
correctly not matching trailing comments like `int32 value  # comment`.

Added unit tests covering bare/indented/with-text comment lines and
trailing comments.

Signed-off-by: Functionhx <2994114386@qq.com>
